_comment: Game feel tuning. Hit-stop times are in real seconds; the game runs at timeScale while frozen.

walk._comment: Player procedural walk. stride = radians of leg cycle per metre; swings in radians (legs) and metres (arms, bob, breath); lean in radians at full sprint.

move._comment: Hero movement. run / sprint: ground speed in m/s (the run and sprint clips play at speed / their own speed in data/avatar.json gait, so raise those together). sprintDrain: stamina per second while sprinting. sprintRegenDelay: seconds after sprinting before stamina refills. staminaRegen: stamina refilled per second.

glow._comment: Soft light around the hero in the dark (night, Shadow, dungeons).

footIK._comment: Feet planted on slopes (scripts/FootIK.cs): hips drop up to maxDrop m, a foot rises up to maxLift m, smooth = how fast the hips follow. plant: a foot this close (m) to the floor in the clip is pinned to the ground. bobDamp: share of the run bounce taken off (0 = clip as made).

camera._comment: lockTurn: how fast the camera swings to a locked target (per second). shoulder / shoulderUp: metres the view sits right of and above the hero, so the aim point is not behind them.
